_comment: Category-B (weak-copyleft) dependencies allowed by exception under P17 / ADR-0004. Each entry is a deliberate, isolated, reviewed allowance — NOT a place to silence Cat-X (GPL/AGPL/source-available). `package` is matched by exact name OR name-prefix (covers per-platform variants). gate:licenses fails on any Cat-B dep not listed here.

categoryB.reason: Unmodified CA certificate bundle required transitively by the optional VieNeu SDK download/HTTP dependencies. MPL applies to the dependency files, not TINA source.
categoryB.disposition: Retained as a separate Python package with upstream notices; no modifications or static linkage into TINA.
categoryB.approved: ADR-0004 Category B implementation record; subject to normal change review

categoryB.reason: Unmodified transitive dependency of the upstream SDK's Gradio dependency. The service uses Python's standard JSON implementation; this dependency remains a separate dynamically loaded extension.
categoryB.disposition: Retained with upstream notices, never statically linked into TINA code.
categoryB.approved: ADR-0004 Category B implementation record; subject to normal change review

categoryB.reason: Unmodified upstream Python-SoXR wheel required by VieNeu. Its resampler is isolated in a loadable native extension; TINA does not link it into its executable or modify it. The service's output resampling uses SciPy instead.
categoryB.disposition: Separate, replaceable Python package/native extension in the optional service, retaining upstream LGPL and native-library notices.
categoryB.approved: ADR-0004 Category B implementation record; subject to normal change review

categoryB.reason: Unmodified transitive audio dependency of VieNeu. The upstream wheel carries a separate shared libsndfile loaded through CFFI; TINA does not statically link or modify it.
categoryB.disposition: Separate, replaceable upstream package/shared library with notices retained. Reference audio and SDK audio-file output are not exposed by the sidecar.
categoryB.approved: ADR-0004 Category B implementation record; subject to normal change review

categoryB.reason: libvips native binary behind `sharp`. LGPL is weak copyleft; it is used unmodified and dynamically linked (a separate .dylib/.so loaded at runtime, never statically bundled into our JS), so it qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B. It enters transitively via @huggingface/transformers' IMAGE pipeline; TINA's mixed lane is AUDIO-only and never instantiates it.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception AND pruned from the deployment artifact (`--no-optional` / omit @img/sharp-*), so no LGPL binary ships.

categoryB.reason: Native CSS transform/minification engine used by the Next/Tailwind toolchain. MPL applies to the unmodified dependency files, not to TINA source or generated CSS.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; dependency remains an isolated build/runtime package managed by pnpm.
categoryB.scope: frontend build pipeline and Next CSS handling
